meta.purpose: Instrument-check perturbation variants for PRD-A. Each is a minimal edit to a DFAH Compliance Triage case (econometrics/benchmarks/compliance_triage/data/alerts.json, dfah-bench 0.1.1) designed to flip the expected label. Used to test that the measured pipelines respond to decision-relevant input changes (degeneracy control), reported jointly with determinism metrics. Not part of the scored primary benchmark.

alerts.edit: country Cayman Islands -> North Korea; flag offshore_destination -> sanctioned_destination
alerts.rationale: Comprehensively sanctioned destination overrides established-customer history; blocked-jurisdiction payment must be escalated

alerts.edit: flags structuring_pattern,cash_intensive_business -> recurring_payment; description reframed as long-standing rent
alerts.description: Monthly rent payment, identical amount paid on the 1st for 36 consecutive months
alerts.rationale: Amount alone is not structuring; long consistent recurring pattern to a known landlord is normal activity

alerts.edit: flag pep_related -> documented_corporate_buyer; sender is a listed REIT, not a PEP family
alerts.description: Commercial real estate purchase by listed property fund, financing documents on file
alerts.rationale: Large amount is expected for the sector; regulated listed buyer with documentation removes the enhanced-due-diligence trigger

alerts.edit: add flag verified_investment_mandate; description notes board-approved mandate on file
alerts.description: Transfer to licensed cryptocurrency exchange pursuant to board-approved investment mandate held on file
alerts.rationale: The open question in the base case (mandate verification) is answered in the input; licensed venue plus documented mandate leaves no outstanding check

alerts.description: Trade payment where supporting invoice was confirmed falsified by document review team
alerts.rationale: Confirmed falsified trade documents are a classic trade-based money laundering indicator; nothing left to clarify, escalation required

alerts.edit: add flag repeated_pattern; description makes it the 14th sub-threshold payment this month to the same recipient
alerts.description: 14th payment of exactly $9,800 this month to the same recipient
alerts.rationale: Repetition of identical sub-threshold amounts to one counterparty converts a benign purchase into a clear structuring pattern

alerts.edit: country Nigeria -> United Kingdom; drop high_risk_country flag; add audited_charity
alerts.description: Charitable program funding to Charity Commission-registered UK charity with published audited accounts
alerts.rationale: End-use risk in the base case came from the high-risk corridor; a domestic registered and audited charity removes it

alerts.edit: add flag ofac_license_verified; description cites valid OFAC general license confirmed by compliance
alerts.description: Energy sector maintenance payment made under OFAC general license, license validity confirmed by compliance and on file
alerts.rationale: The base case escalates pending license verification; a verified applicable license resolves the sanctions question

alerts.edit: receiver becomes a government procurement official's personal account; add flags government_official, corruption_risk
alerts.receiver: Personal account of Ministry of Works procurement director
alerts.description: Consulting fee paid to the personal account of a government procurement official
alerts.rationale: Payment routed to a public official's personal account is a bribery red flag regardless of modest amount

alerts.edit: add flag source_of_funds_verified; description notes settlor source-of-funds documentation completed
alerts.description: Scheduled trust disbursement to named beneficiary; settlor source-of-funds verification completed and documented
alerts.rationale: The base case's open item is source verification; with it completed and documented, a scheduled disbursement to a named beneficiary is routine
